description: Datasets the continuous pipeline may ingest. A source is only fetched and used if it is declared here with a readout direction and a label threshold, because turning a continuous readout into a toxic/not label is a modelling decision and must not be made by a downloader.

rules.direction_required: Every toxicity source states higher_is_toxic or lower_is_toxic. A source without one is skipped, not guessed.
rules.efficacy_never_labelled_toxic: Potency readouts carry kind=efficacy and are excluded from toxicity training.
rules.licence_required: A source is only fetched when redistribution or local use is permitted and stated here.
rules.no_auto_promotion: Fetching data cannot promote an endpoint. Tiers are recomputed by scripts/derive_evidence_tiers.py from the evidence, every run.

sources.name: oligogym_cns_moe_neurotox
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 via OligoGym; see data/oligogym/ATTRIBUTION.md
sources.notes: In vivo functional observational battery. Half of the CNS endpoint.

sources.name: oligogym_cns_hagedorn_calcium
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 via OligoGym; see data/oligogym/ATTRIBUTION.md
sources.notes: In vitro calcium oscillation, LNA gapmers. Toxicity REDUCES oscillation, so the direction is inverted relative to the shipped combined file.

sources.name: oligogym_mcquisten_activity
sources.notes: Potency, not toxicity. Trains the ASO activity model only.

sources.name: oligogym_ichihara_potency
sources.notes: siRNA duplexes written sense.antisense in one field; the normalizer splits them.

sources.name: nar2022_gapmer_hepatotox_screen
sources.fetch_note: Supplementary Table S1 of the paper. PMC serves it only to a real browser; four machine routes are bot-gated, so a human downloads it and passes the path to scripts/evaluate_hepatotox_external.py.
sources.licence: Open access article; the extracted table is a small factual dataset redistributed with citation
sources.notes: External check only, restored 2026-10-30 after the earlier copy was lost with the checkout. 5 positives by the paper's own ALT > 100 U/l criterion cannot validate an endpoint, and the pipeline treats it as directional. Parse verified against the sequences themselves: both motif columns, TGC and TCC, are recomputable from the sequence and match 149 of 149, so the columns are aligned. The second was read as CCC for a while, which is a different motif matching only 44%. What it says: hepatocellular_injury ranks the 5 hepatotoxic gapmers at positions 50, 104, 111, 123 and 141 of 149, ROC-AUC 0.29 [0.10-0.53]. No evidence the endpoint transfers off its own source.

sources.name: asoptimizer_rodent_alt_ast
sources.notes: Roughly 6,000 curated rodent experiments, described as a future release. The single highest-value source for this platform; see docs/DATA_REQUESTS.md. Threshold to be set once the readout scale is known.

sources.name: aso_atlas_patent_gapmers
sources.licence: Apache-2.0 (repository LICENSE); permits redistribution with attribution
sources.notes: Adopted as five per-assay models rather than one pooled model. Pooled it scores 0.18 against the single-study model's 0.26 and transfers at -0.06, because percent inhibition is not comparable across its 81 cell lines. Per context it reaches 0.33 (A431, dose 2000). Two contexts were evaluated and rejected below the 0.15 floor. See scripts/train_context_potency.py and NEGATIVE_RESULTS.md entry 10.
sources.paper: Accurately modeling RNase H-mediated antisense oligonucleotide efficacy. Mol Ther Nucleic Acids 2026, doi:10.1016/j.omtn.2026.103004
sources.fetch_note: Distributed as a 69 MB pickle (data/aso_atlas.pkl). Unpickling executes code: an opcode scan shows it constructs src.formats.Chemistry and modifications.Modification from the authors' own package, and 'src' is generic enough to collide with this repository's own src/. Convert it once with scripts/ingest_aso_atlas.py, which stubs foreign classes so no third-party code runs, then use the parquet it writes.

sources.name: open_tggates_liver
sources.notes: Small molecules, not oligonucleotides. Usable only as a hepatotoxicity prior, which needs enough oligo labels to fine-tune against. Deferred behind asoptimizer_rodent_alt_ast.

sources.name: safesense_human_adverse_events
sources.notes: Human adverse-event atlas for approved ASOs. Surfaced by the literature monitor and assessed: it records events per drug, not outcomes per sequence, so it cannot supply training rows. Useful as a reference for which endpoints matter clinically. Recorded so it is not re-assessed.

sources.name: gallo_sarscov2_shape_gapmers
sources.notes: 24 gapmers designed against single-stranded SARS-CoV-2 regions, ~10 assayed. Too few rows to train on and a viral rather than human target, so not ingested. Kept because it is the only external evidence bearing on target-site accessibility, and it measures accessibility by SHAPE-MaP rather than predicting it. Cited in NEGATIVE_RESULTS entry 12.

sources.name: shape_human_transcripts
sources.notes: Measured accessibility for human transcripts the corpus targets, to test whether the accessibility null is about accessibility or only about ViennaRNA's prediction of it. Candidate sources: RMDB, the SHAPE entries in RNAcentral, published icSHAPE/DMS-MaPseq in human cell lines. Blocked on finding probing data that overlaps the corpus's target genes; a mismatched cell line may be worse than prediction.

sources.name: ionis_patent_hepatotox
sources.licence: patent text is public; extracted factual measurements, cite each publication number
sources.notes: Ingested 2026-10-30 by scripts/ingest_patent_hepatotox.py. 30 US publications, 527 extracted rows collapsed to 444 study-by-sequence observations over 256 sequences, labelled toxic at ALT >= 3x that study's own control at its worst dose. Fold change rather than an absolute ALT because control ALT runs 9 to 57 U/l across these patents and an absolute cut would label whole studies by their baseline. What it did: hepatocellular_injury went from 40 unique sequences (19 positive) to 296 (103 positive), and the source confounding that blocked it is gone, the model now scoring 0.37 against a source-only baseline of 0.23. What it did not do: the model still does not clear the best simple sequence baseline (CI low 0.29 against 0.43) and still does not transfer to the NAR 2022 screen (ROC-AUC 0.31 [0.12-0.47]). The endpoint went validated -> weak and is no longer presented. More data fixed the confounding and revealed that there was no signal underneath it. Assumed, not measured: ps_fraction 1.0 for every row; lna_fraction left empty except where a patent states cEt or LNA wings. Remove with --remove and re-run the pipeline.
